selectionBasis: Choose the battery format and energy capacity first, then confirm the compatible PCS or inverter. A battery-only enclosure is not a complete AC backup system.
Choose off-grid, hybrid or grid-tied operation, then match the phase, battery voltage and PV inputs. An inverter does not store energy; grid-tied models alone do not provide outage backup.
Match the module format to the mounting area, then check current, voltage, weight and rated output. Bifacial rear-side gain depends on the actual installation, not just the nameplate rating.

function: Generates electricity from the wind resource.
selectionBasis: Select the complete generating equipment around the wind resource, rotor, generator and control architecture. Tower, controller, braking, foundation and electrical supply scope must be confirmed for the selected configuration.
